sources.entry: PasteBar - Limitless, Free Clipboard Manager for Mac and Windows. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/PasteBar/PasteBarApp) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: PasteBar is a free, open-source clipboard manager for macOS and Windows that keeps unlimited copy history with organization, search, and PIN-protected collections.
summary.what_it_does: PasteBar stores everything you copy in a searchable history with support for notes, and lets you save custom clips and organize them into collections, tabs, and boards. It handles text, images, files, links, and code snippets, and detects programming languages for syntax highlighting. Protected collections are secured with a PIN, and data is kept in local storage with an option to choose a custom data location. Hotkeys can use up to 3-key combinations, and quick-paste menus and the system menu give fast access to saved items. The README also mentions backup and restore of the clipboard database and images, web scraping and API data extraction, Markdown in notes, and dark theme support.
use_cases: keep unlimited clipboard history on a Mac or Windows PC
save and reuse frequently pasted snippets or templates
store sensitive clips behind a PIN
sync clipboard data via cloud storage or a network drive
back up and restore clipboard history
organize copied code, links, and images into boards
notable: Free and open-source clipboard manager for macOS and Windows
PIN-protected collections and lock screen passcode
Custom data location, useful for syncing across devices
Over 30 special copy/paste operations and Markdown support in notes
Multi-language interface including English, Chinese, Spanish, and German
caveats: License is Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial with a limited commercial use exception, so it is not a standard permissive open-source license
Setup for development requires Rust and Diesel CLI installation
Only macOS and Windows are listed as supported platforms
